name: Ada Lovelace · Wikipedia and Wikidata
description: Search for Ada Lovelace, follow the article's Wikidata link in a second tab, then return and close the walkthrough.
intro: Welcome. We will find the same subject across two public sites. Watch the pointer, typed search and tab order.

steps.title: Open Wikipedia
steps.say: I type Wikipedia's address into Chrome's blank tab.

steps.title: Type Ada Lovelace in Wikipedia
steps.say: I move to Wikipedia's search field and type Ada Lovelace. The matching article appears below the field.

steps.title: Click the Ada Lovelace result
steps.say: I click the result in the search suggestions and check the article heading.

steps.title: Read the Work section
steps.say: I click Work in the contents and scroll down to read more.

steps.title: Open the Wikidata entry
steps.say: I open the article's Tools menu and click its Wikidata item into a second tab.

steps.title: Return to the original article
steps.say: I select Biography in the first tab. Both tabs remain open in their original order.

steps.title: Close the two rehearsal tabs
steps.say: I click the close button on each rehearsal tab.
